measure.sourceTitle: The Alfred Hotel Amsterdam - Google hotels
measure.evidenceText: Google Hotels identifies The Alfred Hotel Amsterdam at Cornelis Schuytstraat 58-60, Amsterdam as a 3-star hotel. It shows $37 nightly and $55 total for 1 night with taxes + fees, and the booking selector visibly shows 2 Adults. The same evidence does not state one room.
measure.referencePeriod: Google Hotels result crawled 3 weeks ago; July 13–14 stay; 2-adult selector
measure.searchQuery: site:google.com/travel/hotels Amsterdam Netherlands 3-star hotel 2 adults 1 room one night price taxes
measure.reason: Strict not_found because one room is not explicitly stated. Selector-relaxed found is a hypothesis label only: the source has exact-city class, non-from nightly price, taxes, and a two-adult one-night selector, but it must not be treated as an observed two-person room quote.
